# QS-CFW-7185-40 - Quality specification - crankshaft blank CFW-7185-40 (4340) Rev E

Scope
- Applies to crankshaft blank CFW-7185-40 manufactured at Plant P2.
- Covers material, dimensional, hardness, and weight requirements for parts CFW-7185-40 produced as forging blanks in 4340 steel.

Requirements table
| Characteristic | Specification | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| Material | 4340 | Per material purchase order |
| Hardness | The hardness range for crankshaft blank CFW-7185-40 (CFW-7185-40) is 39-42 HRC. | Measure at machined witness locations only |
| Bore diameter tolerance | The bore diameter tolerance for crankshaft blank CFW-7185-40 (CFW-7185-40) is ±0.07 mm. | Applies to bores referenced on print |
| Forging weight | The maximum forging weight for crankshaft blank CFW-7185-40 (CFW-7185-40) is 117.8 kg. | Measured after final trim, before heat treatment |

Inspection method
- Visual and dimensional inspection performed per P2 shop inspection workflow. Calibrated measuring instruments shall be used for bore measurements; report measured values against The bore diameter tolerance for crankshaft blank CFW-7185-40 (CFW-7185-40) is ±0.07 mm.
- Hardness testing shall be performed on representative machined witness locations using a Rockwell tester capable of HRC scale. Record results and verify conformance to The hardness range for crankshaft blank CFW-7185-40 (CFW-7185-40) is 39-42 HRC.
- Weight verification performed on calibrated scale and compared to The maximum forging weight for crankshaft blank CFW-7185-40 (CFW-7185-40) is 117.8 kg.
- All inspection data shall be entered into the document control system under this document id QS-CFW-7185-40.

Nonconformance handling
- Parts failing any requirement in the Requirements table shall be segregated and identified. Nonconforming items require a documented disposition: rework, repair, or scrap as determined by engineering and quality.
- Root cause shall be investigated, corrective actions documented, and effectiveness verified before resumption of normal production.
- Records of nonconformance and disposition shall be retained with inspection records for parts CFW-7185-40.
